points: a line of five points 0 to 4; a set is spans [from, to) between them; a result is the coalesced spans of the cells its members cover

days.cell: a day from 2026-06-01; a span is written through its last day

hebrew_days.cell: the same days in the Hebrew calendar; written through the last day

hours.cell: an hour from 2026-06-01T09 on no clock in particular; a span ends as its last hour begins

paris_hours.cell: the same instants on the clock of Europe/Paris

cycle.points: hours of the day 0, 6, 12 and 18 with no date; a span from a later hour to an earlier runs through midnight; a result is the hours covered
